tools.description: list, get, pause, resume or delete (confirm: true) the user's watchlists by name, or 'matches' to see the best-scoring current listings for one. Also shows plan limits.

tools.description: Follow one property (track), stop (untrack) or list tracked ones. Optional price_below threshold and min_drop_pct. Tracked properties produce alerts on every verified price or status change.

tools.name: get_property_history
tools.description: Price and status history for a property: what Realty.Bingo observed (with dates), detected changes, and the listing source's own reported history, kept separate and labelled. Includes cumulative change since first observed. Never infers an earlier price.

tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 properties (property_id) on price, price per sq ft, size, age, HOA, time observed, price changes and stated features (unknown where the listing is silent); optional match scores against a saved watchlist.

tools.description: view the account, plan, usage and every stored preference with its provenance; confirm, reject or delete a learned preference; clear personalization or delete the account (both need confirm: true and an explicit request); set or remove a signed webhook for alerts (paid plans).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_property_alerts · Private data: get_property_details, save_property_watchlist, record_property_feedback · Public sink: manage_realtybingo_account · Destructive: manage_property_watchlist, get_property_alerts, manage_realtybingo_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_property_alerts · Private data: get_property_details, save_property_watchlist, record_property_feedback · Public sink: manage_realtybingo_account · Destructive: manage_property_watchlist, get_property_alerts, manage_realtybingo_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
